Handbook / Finance

Expense reports

Every reimbursement request goes through the finance portal. Receipts must be attached as PDF; photographs of receipts are rejected.

Deadlines

CategoryLimitApprovalDeadline
Meals40 EUR per dayLine manager30 days
Accommodation180 EUR per nightLine manager30 days
Equipment900 EURDepartment head14 days

A claim submitted after the deadline requires a written justification and is approved by the department head rather than the line manager.

Currency

Expenses in a foreign currency are converted at the rate published by the central bank on the date printed on the receipt. Do not use the rate your card issuer applied.

Travel bookings follow a separate procedure described in Travel booking.
